title: TechScript
tagline: A modern programming language and developer ecosystem built from the ground up in Rust.
description: TechScript is a complete programming ecosystem featuring a custom Lexer, Parser, AST architecture, Stack-based Bytecode VM, Standard library, and Package manager — all engineered in Rust for maximum performance and extensibility.
problem: Most modern languages are either overly complex, hard to extend, or lack an integrated developer-first toolchain.
solution: Built from scratch in Rust with a modular Cargo workspace architecture. Features a custom Lexer & Parser producing a strict AST, a Stack-based Bytecode VM, a Standard library, and a Package manager foundation.
features: Custom Lexer & Parser producing strict AST
Future LLVM backend & Language Server (LSP) roadmap
architecture: Lexer → Parser → AST → Bytecode Compiler → Stack VM → Runtime Output
challenges: Designing a type system that balances simplicity with expressiveness
Implementing a stack-based VM from scratch in Rust
Managing Cargo workspace dependencies for 6+ crates
optimizations: Zero-copy string slicing in the Lexer
Arena allocation for AST nodes
Bytecode instruction folding for constant expressions
roadmap: LLVM backend integration for native compilation

title: Aurora Music
tagline: A premium offline Android music player with Material Design 3, built with Flutter.
description: Aurora Music delivers a premium offline listening experience with fluid Material Design 3 animations, intelligent media library management, and a high-performance audio engine — all built cross-platform with Flutter.
problem: Offline music players feel outdated, lack modern Material UI, and offer poor media library management.
solution: Built using Flutter & Dart with Material Design 3, featuring a custom audio playback engine, intelligent media indexing, and smooth 60fps transitions.
features: Modern Material 3 fluid interface with dynamic theming
architecture: Flutter UI → Audio Engine → Media Indexer → Local Storage → Platform Channel → Android SDK
challenges: Achieving 60fps animations while scanning large music libraries
Cross-platform audio engine with consistent latency
Material Design 3 compliance with custom overrides
optimizations: Isolate-based background media scanning
Image caching with size-adaptive quality
Audio buffer management for gapless playback

title: CloudVault
tagline: Secure unlimited cloud storage powered by Telegram's TDLib infrastructure.
description: CloudVault harnesses Telegram's infrastructure via TDLib as a secure, infinite cloud storage backend with folder hierarchy, file previews, and intelligent local caching — built natively in Kotlin.
problem: Traditional cloud storage enforces expensive subscription tiers and rigid storage caps.
solution: Built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, abstracting TDLib as a storage engine with MVVM, Room, Hilt, and Coroutines.
features: Large file chunking & smart local Room cache
Offline file availability & instant folder search
architecture: Compose UI → ViewModel → Repository → TDLib/Room → Telegram API → Cloud
challenges: Abstracting TDLib's complex API into a clean storage interface
Implementing reliable large file chunking with resume
Managing Room database for offline-first metadata cache
optimizations: Predictive pre-fetching for frequently accessed files
Delta sync for modified files
Memory-mapped file reading for large previews

title: TechScript Playground
tagline: In-browser IDE for writing and running TechScript code with live output and syntax highlighting.
description: TechScript Playground is a full-featured web-based IDE that lets developers write, compile, and run TechScript code directly in the browser with real-time output, syntax highlighting, and an interactive terminal.
problem: Trying a new language shouldn't require installing toolchains, configuring PATH, or setting up build systems.
solution: Built a WebAssembly-powered playground using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS that compiles and executes TechScript in the browser with instant feedback.
features: Interactive output terminal with execution history
Zero setup — works on any device
architecture: React UI → CodeMirror Editor → WASM Compiler → Output Terminal → URL State Sync
challenges: Compiling Rust-based compiler to WebAssembly efficiently
Maintaining low latency for live code execution
Handling large code inputs without UI jank
optimizations: Debounced compilation with streaming output
Web Worker offloading for heavy WASM execution
Virtual scrolling for long output logs
